questions.subject: Music
questions.prompt: In C–Am–F–G, which chord acts as the 'IV', built on the fourth scale degree?
questions.why: In C major, the scale degrees run C(1)-D(2)-E(3)-F(4)-G(5)-A(6)-B(7), so a chord built on F is the fourth degree — the 'IV' chord.
